name: claude-eco
description: Token-frugality tooling for Claude Code, published with 82 raw benchmark runs including the negative ones.

plugins.name: claude-eco
plugins.description: Eco mode for Claude Code: /eco and /eco-max skills, an Eco output style, /eco audit and /eco report, and opt-in enforcement hooks. Measured -35% to -57% output tokens across four Claude models on one task (n=5 per arm) and up to -73% on long agentic tasks, with both planted bugs found in every run (267 raw runs published, negative results included); eco-max also lowers reasoning effort - a lever no other terse-mode tool touches.
